name: amber_train_review_v1

reviewer.method: Direct visual inspection of all63 exact-question contact cards using image-view tools, with original images and six supplemental detail crops inspected for uncertain cases. This is automated review, not human adjudication or independent ground truth.

scope: Training-view retain/exclude overlay for all51 AMBER TRAIN cross-task annotation candidates, ten earlier action/scalar/relation suspects and two consistent cycling controls. Every official question, gold label, image and train/dev/test assignment is preserved.

policy.retain_definition: The original supplied label is supported confidently under the documented visible-object interpretation.
policy.excluded_definition: Likely incorrect supplied label or unresolved ambiguity; exclusion does not supply a replacement answer.
policy.depictions: For resolved kite/sign/painting cases, distinguish an actual object in the photographed scene from its shape or depiction.
policy.sun_visibility: Require identifiable visible sun rather than inferring a sun solely from illumination or reflection.
limitations: Targeted candidate review is not a dataset-wide error-rate estimate.
Automated visual assessment may be mistaken; exclusions are conservative and retain rationale for further review.
Unflagged training items have not all been visually adjudicated.
Original official benchmark exports and all held-out labels remain unchanged.
